subject: POC prompt & log onboarding — schema, privacy checklist, and next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@medcord.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC prompt & log onboarding — schema, privacy checklist, and next steps

Hi Anita — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track items for the MedCord trial: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Goal: 2-week pilot to validate discharge-summary summarization and triage prompts; success measured by >85% accuracy on clinical category extraction and latency < 400ms p95 for single-user flows.
- Data you’ll provide: de-identified prompt logs (chat/exported EHR snippets) and a small prompt seed set for evaluation.
- Redwood will run an eval suite and return a results dashboard + suggested prompt edits and quantization profile.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- MedCord: export ~2k conversational prompts and 200 labeled verification examples (anonymized) — target upload by 2027-05-25 EOD — Anita (owner)
- Redwood: provide upload checklist + schema, S3 presigned option, and redaction guidance — Kimberly (owner) — by 2027-05-23
- Redwood CS: prepare eval baseline and template metrics (precision/recall per intent, latency distribution) — Sean (owner) — start 2027-05-26

Privacy & security (short):
- Please remove direct patient identifiers (names, MRNs, SSNs). If you need, we can provide a small redaction script to run prior to upload.
- If you prefer not to use presigned S3, we can accept AES-256 encrypted archive via secure transfer; we’ll share the key exchange process.

Upload requirements (high-level):
- Format: CSV or newline-delimited JSON. Each row/message should include: message_id, timestamp (ISO), prompt_text, context_text (optional), label (if available), metadata.tags. See attached sample CSV.
- Filename convention: medcord_prompts_YYYYMMDD.[csv|ndjson]
- Expected size: ~50–500MB compressed; if larger, let us know and we’ll provide multipart S3 guidance.

Attached: medcord_prompt_sample_20270522.csv, redwood_upload_instructions_v1.md

Can you confirm the upload ETA and whether you want the redaction script? I’ll loop in Marissa for trial success criteria and timelines after your confirmation.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0183


From: Anita Shah <anita@medcord.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & log onboarding — schema, privacy checklist, and next steps

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Redaction: we can run your script; please send it as a small Python tool we can vet (PII removal only).
2) Labels: we have ~150 verified labels for clinical triage, but they’re in an internal spreadsheet. We can export a CSV mapping message_id -> label by Friday.
3) Upload method: presigned S3 is fine but security will want the presign window limited; please provide guidance.
4) Sample distribution: we’ll try to surface a representative mix across inpatient/outpatient and three top conditions — will include sampling notes.

We plan to have the dataset and label export ready by 2027-05-25 EOD as requested. I’ll send a quick note when upload starts.

—Anita
Product Lead, Integrations
MedCord Health
anita@medcord.com

Date: 2027-05-23T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & log onboarding — schema, privacy checklist, and next steps

Thanks Anita — appreciate the quick reply. Attaching the redaction script and a short checklist in the Drive (link below). Key follow-ups and acceptance criteria we’ll use for the POC eval: 

Eval acceptance criteria (candidate list):
- Data completeness: >= 90% messages include prompt_text and timestamp
- Label coverage: at least 150 labeled examples spanning top 5 intents
- Quality: gold labels agree with Redwood annotator sample at >= 85% F1 (for triage intents)
- Performance objective: inference latency p95 < 400ms on hosted Redwood endpoint with your typical prompt length (~120 tokens)

Suggested eval buckets for prompts (we'll validate with your sample):
- Short inquiries (<50 tokens)
- Long context (>250 tokens)
- Ambiguous intent (requires disambiguation)
- Multi-turn follow-ups (prompt includes prior messages)

Upload instructions (high-level):
- Presigned S3: we will issue a presigned PUT for a single archive (window: 24 hours). If you need shorter, tell us. Files should be gzipped and follow filename convention.
- Schema (CSV columns): message_id, timestamp_iso, prompt_text, context_text, label, source (api/ui), sampling_bucket, reviewer_notes

Security notes:
- We recommend running the attached redaction script locally and keeping a copy of originals internal. Redwood will only access the uploaded archive for the trial and will delete per the retention clause in the trial agreement.

Timeline update:
- 2027-05-25: MedCord uploads dataset (Anita)
- 2027-05-26 to 2027-05-28: Redwood ingest + baseline eval (Sean & team)
- 2027-06-01: Shared results + recommended prompt edits + next steps meeting (Marissa to schedule)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-medcord-poc
Presign: will send presigned link in separate secure email once you confirm window length.

I’ll attach the redaction script (redact_pii.py) and a short README to the Drive. Let me know if you want us to run an initial smoke test on a 100-message sample first — often helps catch formatting issues.

Best,
Kimberly

From: Anita Shah <anita@medcord.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & log onboarding — schema, privacy checklist, and next steps

Kimberly — quick update: upload scheduled for today at ~3pm PT. We ran the redaction script on a 200-message sample and it behaved as expected; will include a short QA report with the upload.

Attachments in upload: medcord_prompt_sample_20270525.csv (2k rows), medcord_label_map_20270525.csv (150 labeled rows), qa_checks_20270525.txt

Presign window: please issue a 12-hour presigned PUT (that satisfies our security team). If possible, include a check for successful MD5 after upload.

We’ll mark this as ready in HubSpot once upload completes.

Thanks — Anita
